News.title: Apex Institute Granted Autonomy Extension with Highest NAAC A++ Grade
News.summary: Peer review committee praises the institute for world-class laboratory infrastructure, high placement ratio, and vibrant startup incubation ecosystem.

News.author: Office of the Principal

Department.name: Department of Computer Engineering
Department.hodMessage: Our focus is on blending computational theory with high-impact software engineering in Cloud Systems, Cyber Security, and Distributed Computing.
Department.overview: Established in 1993, the Department of Computer Engineering is accredited by the NBA and boasts state-of-the-art specialized computing labs, NVIDIA GPUs, and an active ACM student chapter.
Department.vision: To produce ethically sound, globally competent computer engineering professionals capable of leading software innovation.
Department.mission: Delivering hands-on curriculum, fostering collaborative research, and instilling entrepreneurial aptitude.

Department.name: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
Department.hodMessage: Empowering future engineers with machine intelligence, neural architectures, deep learning, and ethical data governance frameworks.
Department.overview: A pioneering interdisciplinary department equipped with high-performance computing clusters dedicated to computer vision, natural language processing, and big data analytics.
Department.vision: To emerge as a premier center of intelligence engineering driving societal transformation.
Department.mission: Providing interdisciplinary curriculum aligned with top industry frontiers and academic research.

Department.name: Electronics & Telecommunication
Department.hodMessage: From 5G communications to VLSI design and embedded systems, our department bridges hardware architecture with high-speed digital communications.
Department.overview: Accredited with NBA, featuring Center of Excellence in IoT, Cadence VLSI tools, and collaborative projects with Texas Instruments.
Department.vision: Excellence in electronics and telecommunication engineering through applied knowledge and industry partnership.
Department.mission: Empowering students with hardware-software co-design abilities and telecommunication fundamentals.

Department.name: Mechanical Engineering
Department.hodMessage: Combining classical thermodynamics and mechanics with modern CAD/CAM, robotics automation, and Electric Vehicle technology.
Department.overview: One of the founding branches of the institute with extensive workshop facilities, CNC machines, wind tunnel lab, and championship-winning SAE BAJA team.
Department.vision: Developing world-class mechanical design engineers and industrial innovators.
Department.mission: Providing strong analytical foundations, hands-on workshop training, and exposure to smart manufacturing.

Department.name: Civil Engineering & Infrastructure
Department.hodMessage: Designing sustainable urban infrastructure, green buildings, resilient structural frameworks, and smart water management systems.
Department.overview: Renowned for industrial consultancy in geotechnical testing, structural audit, environmental impact assessment, and GIS surveying.
Department.vision: Building sustainable and resilient infrastructure leaders for modern urban societies.
Department.mission: Instilling expertise in structural design, environmental sustainability, and modern construction management.

Department.name: Chemical Engineering
Department.hodMessage: Advancing green chemistry, renewable energy biofuels, sustainable process engineering, and nano-materials.
Department.overview: Equipped with pilot-scale process synthesis units, mass transfer distillation labs, and chemical reaction engineering simulation suites.
Department.vision: Pioneering clean process engineering and sustainable biochemical technology.
Department.mission: Promoting process safety, eco-friendly synthesis, and strong industry linkages.

Department.name: Department of Management Studies (MBA)
Department.hodMessage: Developing visionary business leaders with specialized competencies in Tech Management, Finance, Marketing, and Operations.
Department.overview: Premier business school department with Bloomberg-style business analytics lab, incubation cell, and corporate mentorship program.
Department.vision: To cultivate entrepreneurial visionaries and agile corporate managers.
Department.mission: Case-based pedagogy, corporate executive interactions, and business analytics integration.

Department.name: Department of Computer Applications (MCA)
Department.hodMessage: Fostering full-stack enterprise software architects, cloud engineers, and mobile application specialists.
Department.overview: Intensive 2-year professional degree focusing on enterprise Java/Python frameworks, DevOps, cloud deployment, and system architecture.
Department.vision: Excellence in application development and modern enterprise software practices.
Department.mission: Industry live projects, hackathons, and continuous technical certification tracks.

Course.title: B.Tech in Computer Engineering
Course.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/CS with min 50% marks + Valid MHT-CET / JEE Main Score.
Course.description: Comprehensive curriculum covering Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems, Cloud Computing, Compiler Design, and Cyber Security.
curriculum: Sem 1-2: Engineering Physics, Calculus, C Programming, Digital Electronics
Sem 3-4: OOP Java, Data Structures, Discrete Math, Computer Organization
Sem 5-6: Operating Systems, Database Management, Computer Networks, Software Engineering
Sem 7-8: Cloud Computing, Machine Learning, Capstone Major Project, Industry Internship
Course.careerOpportunities: Software Engineer, Systems Architect, Cloud DevOps Engineer, Cyber Security Specialist

Course.title: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
Course.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/CS with min 50% marks + Valid MHT-CET / JEE Main Score.
Course.description: Specialized program diving deep into Neural Networks, Deep Learning, Big Data Frameworks, NLP, and Computer Vision.
curriculum: Sem 1-2: Linear Algebra, Statistics, Python Programming, Applied Electronics
Sem 3-4: Foundations of AI, Data Analysis, Data Warehousing, Optimization Algorithms
Sem 5-6: Machine Learning, Deep Neural Nets, Computer Vision, Big Data Analytics
Sem 7-8: Reinforcement Learning, MLOps, Generative AI, Industrial Project
Course.careerOpportunities: AI Engineer, Data Scientist, ML Ops Specialist, Business Intelligence Architect

Course.title: M.Tech in Computer Engineering
Course.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in Computer / IT / Electronics with min 50% marks + Valid GATE score.
Course.description: Advanced master course focusing on high-performance computing, distributed ledger algorithms, and autonomous system research.
curriculum: Sem 1: Advanced Algorithms, Parallel Computing, Research Methodology
Sem 2: Cloud Native Architectures, Deep Learning Frontiers, Elective I & II
Sem 3: Dissertation Phase I, Research Publication
Sem 4: Dissertation Phase II, Defense and Tech Transfer
Course.careerOpportunities: Principal Research Engineer, Senior Systems Architect, Academic Faculty

Course.title: B.Tech in Electronics & Telecommunication
Course.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry with min 50% + MHT-CET / JEE Main.
Course.description: Modern electronics curriculum spanning RF design, 5G signal processing, embedded IoT microcontrollers, and FPGA programming.
curriculum: Sem 1-2: Basic Electrical & Electronics, Engineering Mechanics, Applied Chemistry
Sem 3-4: Electronic Devices & Circuits, Signals & Systems, Microprocessors 8086/ARM
Sem 5-6: Digital Signal Processing, Antenna & Wave Propagation, VLSI Design
Sem 7-8: Wireless Communication, IoT Protocols, Embedded Robotics, Capstone Project
Course.careerOpportunities: VLSI Design Engineer, Embedded Firmware Engineer, Telecom Network Architect

Course.title: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
Course.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry with min 50% + MHT-CET / JEE Main.
Course.description: Engineering excellence in thermodynamics, finite element analysis, robotics, mechatronics, and Electric Vehicle powertrains.
curriculum: Sem 1-2: Workshop Practice, Engineering Graphics, Material Science
Sem 3-4: Strength of Materials, Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, Kinematics
Sem 5-6: Heat Transfer, Turbo Machinery, Mechatronics, CAD/CAM/CAE
Sem 7-8: EV Powertrain Design, Industrial Automation, Renewable Energy, Major Project
Course.careerOpportunities: Automotive Design Engineer, Manufacturing Specialist, Thermal Analyst, EV Systems Engineer

Course.title: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
Course.eligibility: Graduation in any discipline with min 50% marks + Valid MAH-MBA-CET / CAT / CMAT / MAT score.
Course.description: Specializations in Financial Management, Marketing, Human Resource Management, Operations & Supply Chain, and Business Analytics.
curriculum: Sem 1: Management Principles, Financial Accounting, Managerial Economics, Org Behavior
Sem 2: Marketing Management, Operations Research, Business Law, Analytics Lab
Sem 3: Specialization Core & Electives, Summer Internship Project
Sem 4: Strategic Management, Corporate Governance, Final Capstone Project
Course.careerOpportunities: Investment Banker, Product Manager, Marketing Strategist, Supply Chain Consultant

Course.title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
Course.eligibility: BCA / B.Sc (Computer Science / IT) or Bachelor degree with Mathematics at 10+2 or Graduate level + MAH-MCA-CET.
Course.description: Industry-geared program focusing on Full Stack Web Architecture, Cloud Deployments, Microservices, and Mobile Apps.
curriculum: Sem 1: Advanced Java, Python & Web Technologies, RDBMS, Software Engineering
Sem 2: Cloud Computing, DevOps & CI/CD, Enterprise Frameworks (Spring / React)
Sem 3: AI & Machine Learning, Mobile Computing, Agile Project Management
Sem 4: Full 6-Month Industry Live Internship & Project Defense
Course.careerOpportunities: Full Stack Developer, Cloud Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer

Course.title: Ph.D. in Computer Engineering & Technology
Course.eligibility: Master Degree in relevant discipline with min 55% marks + Valid PET / GATE / NET qualification.
Course.description: Doctoral research center affiliated with University research council. Focus areas include AI ethics, Quantum Cryptography, and Edge IoT.
curriculum: Coursework: Advanced Research Methodology, Quantitative Data Techniques, Domain Elective
Comprehensive Viva & Research Proposal Defense
Annual Progress Review Seminars and High-Impact IEEE/Scopus Journal Publications
Final Thesis Submission & Open Defense

Admission.title: Online Application & Registration
Admission.description: Register on the Central Admission Process (CAP) portal or the Institute Level Application portal. Upload academic transcripts, photo, and entrance scorecard.
Admission.eligibilityCriteria: Passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects alongside Chemistry/CS.
Admission.requiredDocuments: 10th & 12th Marksheets, Entrance Exam Scorecard (MHT-CET / JEE), Leaving Certificate, Domicile/Nationality Certificate.

Admission.title: Document Verification & Merit List
Admission.description: Physical or e-scrutiny verification of uploaded credentials at the designated facilitation center. Publication of provisional and final state/institute merit lists.
Admission.eligibilityCriteria: Clear verification of caste/category certificates if claiming reservations.
Admission.requiredDocuments: Original documents verification + 2 sets of attested photocopies.

Admission.title: Option Form Filling & Seat Allotment
Admission.description: Submit institutional preference choices during CAP Round I, II, and III. Check allotment status and freeze/float options.
Admission.eligibilityCriteria: Valid CAP enrollment pin and merit rank.
Admission.requiredDocuments: Seat Allotment Letter, Provisional Admission Receipt.

Admission.title: Reporting to Campus & Enrollment Confirmation
Admission.description: Report in person to the Apex Campus Admission Cell with original certificates and fee payment demand draft or net banking receipt.
Admission.eligibilityCriteria: Allotted seat in CAP or approved institutional quota selection.
Admission.requiredDocuments: Medical Fitness Certificate, Migration Certificate (if from outside state board), 5 Passport Photos.

Admission.title: B.Tech Engineering (Open / General Category)
Admission.description: Approved by State Fee Regulating Authority (FRA). Inclusive of tuition, computer lab fees, gymkhana, library, and development fund.

Admission.title: B.Tech Engineering (OBC / EBC / EWS Reserved)
Admission.description: 50% tuition fee concession under Maharashtra State Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulk Yojna.
Admission.eligibilityCriteria: Family income < ₹8,00,000 with valid income certificate
Admission.requiredDocuments: Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar, Non-Creamy Layer Certificate

Admission.title: M.Tech / Post Graduate Courses
Admission.description: Approved annual fees for two-year master degree programs. GATE scholarship of ₹12,400/month applicable for qualified candidates.

Admission.title: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
Admission.description: Two-year management program fee covering case study licenses, enterprise software training, and industrial immersion.
Admission.eligibilityCriteria: Graduate in any discipline + MBA CET / CAT

Facility.name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Central Knowledge Center (Library)
Facility.shortDesc: Over 85,000 printed volumes, IEEE, Springer, ACM e-journals, and a 24x7 digital reading wing.
Facility.detailedDesc: Spanning across 25,000 sq.ft., the Central Library features RFID book circulation, air-conditioned multimedia learning carrels, automated plagiarism checking tools, and institutional repository access.
Facility.timings: Monday - Saturday: 07:30 AM to 11:00 PM (24x7 during exams)

Facility.name: High-Performance Supercomputing & AI Innovation Lab
Facility.shortDesc: Equipped with NVIDIA DGX A100 GPU clusters and 10Gbps dedicated fiber backhaul for neural network training.
Facility.detailedDesc: Built in collaboration with leading technology partners, this laboratory supports complex simulations in computational fluid dynamics, deep neural networks, and autonomous robotics.

Facility.name: Sir Visvesvaraya Advanced Manufacturing Workshop
Facility.shortDesc: 5-Axis CNC Milling machines, Wire-cut EDM, 3D additive printing suites, and automated laser cutting.

Facility.name: Olympic-Standard Sports Complex & Gymnasium
Facility.shortDesc: Floodlit 400m synthetic athletic track, football ground, basketball courts, and modern indoor gym.
Facility.detailedDesc: Apex Institute fosters all-round development with professional coaches for cricket, football, basketball, badminton, table tennis, and yoga.

Facility.name: On-Campus Student Residential Hostels (Boys & Girls)
Facility.shortDesc: Modern twin & triple sharing furnished rooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, biometric security, and hygienic dining mess.
Facility.detailedDesc: Separate gated hostels for boys and girls with 24/7 CCTV surveillance, resident wardens, solar water heaters, study lounges, and medical clinic on call.

Facility.name: Rabindranath Tagore Multi-Purpose Auditorium
Facility.shortDesc: Acoustically engineered 1,200 seat auditorium with 4K digital projection and surround audio.
Facility.detailedDesc: The center stage for national conferences, university convocations, corporate leadership seminars, and annual cultural celebrations.

Testimonial.quote: The rigorous algorithm labs, hackathon culture, and mentorship from professors at Apex gave me the technical confidence to clear competitive global software interviews seamlessly.
Working on the SAE BAJA buggy in the campus workshop until midnight taught me more about hands-on mechanics, team leadership, and design resilience than any textbook alone could.
Apex provided direct access to NVIDIA DGX clusters and high-impact industry research projects from our third year. It transformed my engineering career completely.
